title: Require reviewed exact Docker image digest before syntax broker execution
summary: Hardened P00 default-disabled Docker syntax validation so a well-formed, different Docker Hub Python digest can no longer substitute for the explicitly reviewed image. Regression tests confirm rejection happens before any Docker command. No host deployment or model-authored execution is claimed.
migration_notes: No released user data or installed host migration. An approved base-image rotation requires reviewed allowlist update, independent image provenance review and new CI evidence.
